### Overview

The Stanford CS231N introduction lecture ("Stanford CS231N Deep Learning for Computer Vision | Spring 2025 | Lecture 1: Introduction", presented by Prof. Fei-Fei Li) was opened on YouTube and is currently playing. Three prominent benchmark datasets discussed in the historical overview of computer vision during the lecture were identified along with their timestamps. Their official live source websites have been pulled up in individual tabs with active download links.

---

### Datasets Mentioned in the Lecture

1. **PASCAL Visual Object Classes (PASCAL VOC)**
   - **Timestamp in Lecture**: `25:33` (Slide displayed at `25:35`: *"PASCAL Visual Object Challenge"*)
   - **Lecture Context**: Prof. Fei-Fei Li explains the early-2000s transition when the internet and digital photography enabled the visual recognition community to work with standardized benchmarks of thousands of labeled objects across categories.
   - **Download Link & Source**: Oxford Visual Geometry Group (VGG) PASCAL VOC 2012 challenge page:
     - Training/Validation data: `https://www.robots.ox.ac.uk/~vgg/projects/pascal/VOC/voc2012/VOCtrainval_11-May-2012.tar` (~2 GB)
     - Development kit: `https://www.robots.ox.ac.uk/~vgg/projects/pascal/VOC/voc2012/VOCdevkit_18-May-2011.tar`

2. **Caltech 101**
   - **Timestamp in Lecture**: `25:39` (Slide displayed at `25:35`: *"Caltech 101 images"*)
   - **Lecture Context**: Cited alongside PASCAL VOC as one of the foundational early datasets that moved computer vision beyond isolated object instances toward broader multi-class categorization.
   - **Download Link & Source**: Official CaltechDATA repository record:
     - Direct ZIP download: `https://data.caltech.edu/records/mzrjq-6wc02/files/caltech-101.zip?download=1` (131 MB)

3. **ImageNet (ILSVRC)**
   - **Timestamp in Lecture**: `32:27` to `33:15` (Slide displayed at `32:35`: *"IMAGENET Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge"*)
   - **Lecture Context**: Prof. Fei-Fei Li describes identifying the data bottleneck in machine learning, curating the 15-million image ImageNet ontology across 22,000 categories, and launching the 1.4-million image / 1,000-class ILSVRC benchmark that catalyzed the 2012 deep learning revolution (AlexNet).
   - **Download Link & Source**: Official ImageNet download portal:
     - Portal: `https://www.image-net.org/download.php`
     - Download access: Provides direct academic download access and links to the official ILSVRC challenge subset on Kaggle under standard research terms of access.
